sloka: मृते मयि गते रामे वनम् पुरुषपुङ्गवे ।सेदानीम् विधवा राज्यम् सपुत्रा कारयिष्यसि ॥२-१२-९५॥
transliteration: mṛte mayi gate rāme vanam puruṣapuṅgave ।sedānīm vidhavā rājyam saputrā kārayiṣyasi ॥2-12-95॥

translations.english: O my enemy, O wicked Kaikeyi, after Rama, the foremost of men, has left for the forest your desires will be fulfilled. And after my death, you as a widow along with your son will rule the kingdom.
